messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one weekend day – either Friday or Monday, or a holiday observed on a nearby weekday.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Jan 1 2023 fell on a Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, BC, NB, PEI, Saskatchewan) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Friday, Apr 7; the following weekend (Sat 8–Sun 9) completes the long weekend. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Monday, May 22 (the last Monday before May 25). |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Jul 1 2023 was a Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Nov 11 2023 was a Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, Nov 13. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Dec 25 2023 was a Monday, giving a long weekend from the preceding Saturday. |

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Observance Rules** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada usually observes it on the nearest weekday (Monday if it falls on Saturday, or Friday if it falls on Sunday).  
2. **Province‑Specific Holidays** – Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Heritage Day in Manitoba). If your app needs province‑specific data, you’ll need to add those separately.  
3. **Calendar APIs** – Many calendar services (Google Calendar API, Microsoft Graph, etc.) expose public holiday data per country and region. You can query those APIs for dynamic updates instead of hard‑coding dates.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
